page.overview:
Who is Deku Scrub?

They are plant-based creatures that have skin seemingly made of wood and hair and "clothing" made of leaves and flowers, and spit Deku Nuts at their enemies when threatened. They usually appear in a small, flower-like tuft of foliage which they hide within when threatened. They normally appear as enemies, but despite their antagonistic nature some tend to be friendly, at least when they believe it to be to their own benefit. It is rumored that a Deku Scrub's disposition can change drastically depending on the type of tree they are born from.

As enemies, Deku Scrubs tend to hide in grassy or flower shrubs, and pop out when provoked to spit a Deku Nut at Link. When approached they will quickly retreat into their shrubs where they cannot be touched. In , they sometimes hide in Deku Flowers instead, which can be used after their defeat. While they cannot be harmed by direct combat, they are susceptible to long-range weapons, but can also be defeated by using a Shield to deflect their Deku Nuts back at them. When harmed, the Deku Scrub will be quick to surrender. This same strategy is also applied to the other variations of the Deku Scrub, including Business Scrubs and Mad Scrubs, which will jump out of their shrubs when first harmed.

Dekus can deal with water, but if they happen to venture in deep areas they will hop on the water to survive drowning. Like plants, too much water can hurt them. Luckily, Dekus are usually light enough to stand on Lily Pads, granting safer travel over the swampy waters that the Dekus of Termina call home. In his Deku form, Link is able to skip across water, but cannot swim. Dekus are also highly flammable, and rightly so, as they are wood-based creatures.

Some Deku Scrubs in also have propellers on their heads which allows for flight.
